description_en: Modifies the basic attributes of an office network (formerly workspace), such as the office network name and whether to grant local administrator permissions to cloud computer users
description_zh: 修改办公网络（原工作区）的基本属性，例如办公网络名称、是否为使用云电脑的用户赋予本地管理员权限等
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-office-site-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-8823980000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyOfficeSiteAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The access method allowed when connecting to cloud computers.

The VPC connection method depends on the Alibaba Cloud PrivateLink service, which is free of charge. If this parameter is set to `VPC` or `Any`, the system automatically activates the PrivateLink service for you
parameters.help_zh:
连接云电脑时允许使用的接入方式。

VPC连接方式依赖于阿里云私网连接PrivateLink服务，该服务不收取费用。该参数设置为`VPC`或者`Any`时，系统将自动为您开通私网连接服务
parameters.name: desktop_access_type

parameters.help_en:
The office network name. The name must be 2 to 255 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-).    
Default value: empty
parameters.help_zh:
办公网络名称。长度为2~255个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。    
默认值：空
parameters.name: office_site_name

parameters.help_en: This parameter applies only to convenience account-based office networks. Specifies whether secondary authentication is required during logon. If logon secondary authentication is enabled, the system checks whether the logon account has security risks when a convenience user logs on to the client. If a risk is detected, the system sends a verification code to the email address associated with the account. The convenience user can log on to the client only after passing the verification code check
parameters.help_zh: 仅适用于便捷账号办公网络，表示登录时是否需要二次验证。如果开启了登录二次验证，则便捷用户登录客户端时，系统将检测登录账号是否有安全风险。如果有风险，系统将发送验证码到该账号关联的邮箱，便捷用户使用验证码验证通过后才能登录客户端
parameters.name: need_verify_login_risk

parameters.help_en: This parameter applies only to convenience account-based office networks. Specifies whether to enable device verification. For AD-based office networks, this parameter is empty
parameters.help_zh: 仅适用于便捷账号办公网络，表示是否开启设备校验。对于AD办公网络，该参数值为空
parameters.name: need_verify_zero_device

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to grant local administrator permissions to cloud computer users
parameters.help_zh: 是否为使用云电脑的用户赋予本地管理员权限
parameters.name: enable_admin_access

parameters.help_en: The Authority URL of the identity authentication service
parameters.help_zh: 身份认证服务的 Authority 地址
parameters.name: authority_host

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID of the identity provider
parameters.help_zh: 身份提供方的租户 ID
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The domain name of the enterprise AD
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The client ID registered with the identity provider application
parameters.help_zh: 身份提供方应用注册的客户端 ID
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: The client secret registered with the identity provider application
parameters.help_zh: 身份提供方应用注册的客户端密钥
parameters.name: client_secret

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID. Only one vSwitch is supported
parameters.help_zh: 交换机ID。目前仅支持配置一个
parameters.name: vswitch_id
